text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been smooth sailing toward the
Grand
Concert, thanks to the help of
students, fans,
staff, and the URA.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
This is where the Grand Concert will
take place!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: It's so big!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
We do still have a lot of details to
hammer out,
but...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Today, I wanted to let the students get
a sense of
the scale of the place and the
features of the
different stages.

text_block_list.name: Assembled Students
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Could anyone spare a
moment to help me
carry these booth
materials?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Right here! Falco's got you co—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
No, that won't do! You all have training
after this.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So please, don't tire yourselves out.
Leave setting
up the stages to us fans.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the Grand Concert isn't the
only stage
you want to stand on, is it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you all have wishes the Grand
Concert can't make come true—feelings
of gratitude only
a winning concert can
convey.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
We've got nothing to do at stage C! I'll
help!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Us fans are here to support you students
in any
way we can.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: We can take care of things here.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
All you have to do in return is shine your
brightest
on the stages we set up for
you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Okay!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I've been wondering, what songs are we
going to
sing at the concert?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Am I correct to assume we will pick from
the
songs we've already been singing?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I actually have some ideas about that.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
First off, I think we should avoid G1
songs. They're special songs that can
only be sung after a victory, and I think
we should keep them that
way.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Agreed.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So I was thinking of asking everyone who
wants to perform whether they'd prefer
to sing alone or in
a group, then have
original songs made for them.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Can't leave anyone out. I've
already
gotten our songwriter on board.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The purpose of this concert is to let
everybody sing for themselves, and I'm
sure they all have
different feelings they
want to put into song.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer, I'm counting on you to take
care of
the task I entrusted you with!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well? No need to keep secrets. What is
this "task"
you've been entrusted with?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you and the girls think of
lyrics for
this song?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is an arrangement that's been

tailor-made for the Grand Concert.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...No, my role is that of a bystander.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
The lyrics should come from those
running in the
here and now.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you write them with us fans in
mind,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I put on the song Light Hello gave me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It's beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: New mission received. Understood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We rack our brains over the lyrics on the
bus ride
back to the academy.
